interface.name: df_shell

description.summary: chrome-surface factory for trusted session clients

interface.description: Creates `df_layer_surface`s. Binding this global requires a successful `df_core.authenticate` (T-07 trust model).

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a chrome surface on a layer

request.description: Turn an existing `wl_surface` into a chrome surface. The compositor assigns it a reserved zone (when `exclusive_zone` is set) and places it on the requested layer. `output` NULL means the compositor picks the output the surface should anchor to (the primary output).

enum.name: layer
enum.description: Matches wlr-layer-shell's ordering so the mental model carries over: the wallpaper/desktop reveal sits on `background`, normal chrome on `top`, transient chrome (menus, OSD) on `overlay`.

interface.name: df_layer_surface
interface.description: Requests may be sent before the first commit; the compositor sends a `configure` with the resolved size and serial, which the client must ack. When the output is resized the compositor reconfigures.

description.summary: anchor edges; 0 means centred on the output

request.name: set_size
request.description: A non-zero width/height is a request, not a guarantee: the compositor may clamp it to the output and reports the final size in `configure`.

request.name: set_exclusive_zone

description.summary: reserve this many pixels on the anchored edge

request.description: The reserved zone is subtracted from the usable area (Zoom target) and reported to the shell as an output property. Negative values keep the surface out of the reserved-zone accounting (an overlay).

request.name: set_keyboard_interaction

description.summary: keyboard focus policy for this surface

request.description: `none` never takes keyboard focus; `on_demand` takes it when clicked; `exclusive` takes it for as long as it is mapped (like a modal OSD).

description.summary: the compositor will not use this surface any more
